title: Bakery and Letters
author: Ivo Underhill
blurb: Casper Amberdale, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
